name: Ring of Elemental Strength
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 10th; Slot ring; Price 5,000 gp (simple), 10,000 gp (composite); Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This simple pale stone sits atop a plain steel band, flickering every so often with unknown power. When worn by a creature who possesses a kinetic blast, add 1 damage of the same type their simple blast deals for each of its damage dice. A composite ring of elemental strength can augment a creature’s composite blasts as well as their simple blasts.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,500 gp (simple), 5,000 gp (composite) Forge Ring, kineticist 10th
